blocks.text: TP-Link USB WiFi 6 Adapter for Desktop PC AX1800 Wireless Network Adapter with 2.4GHz/5GHz High Gain Dual Band 5dBi Antennas, Supports Windows 11/10 (Archer TX20U Plus)

High Speed, Dual Band WiFi
The Archer TX20U Plus grants your PC access to 802.11ax technology while receiving WiFi signals on two separate bands, boosting speeds up to 1.8 Gbps (up to 574 Mbps on the 2.4GHz band and 1201 Mbps on the 5GHz band). Granting you better networking experience for all your online needs.
Please use USB 3.0 port to ensure optimal performance and disable your device’s internal Wi-Fi first before installing

Industry-Leading Support
TP-Link offers 24/7 technical support and 2-year warranty for most home products, 1 more year than most networking brands.
